limits: Diagnostic includes live source-skinned characters, LOD, a directional shadow map, HDR postprocess, screen lens ink, and pooled world/special FX. Stage environment shading is locally approximated and weapon projectile/device meshes are not rendered. Boss mode renders source-exported geometry, but its animation and material response remain an approximation; QA12 is not claimed.
gl_renderer: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 with Max-Q Design/PCIe/SSE2
